text.text_excerpt: We stopped in here after another New Year's Eve party was kind of dull and we were happy to find a good crowd, a good beer selection and generous seating. This is more a sports bar than an Irish pub, but the folks are really friendly and they have some of my favorite beers on tap, so I was happy. There are plenty of tvs, so it would be a good place to watch a game and the drinks are reasonably priced, considering the location. The bartender was nice and the place is pretty clean.

I meannnnnn a great alcohol and beer selection, awesome bartender (hey CAROLYN!), regulars, nice tourists and multiple tv's. Ryan's Pub is just a great bar all around. It's a plus it's in walking distance to many food places and attractions. You can bring in outside food and there's actually an agreement with the seafood restaurant neighbors where they'll deliver your order to the bar! (They have great oysters, fyi) Can you say "winning!"??!!! Also, when i used to work at the Westin Hotel, I'd recommend Ryan's for a venue to watch the NHL games; being that New Orleans isn't a hockey city but Ryan's comes through in the clutch and air "all hockey games", as advertised at the entrance.

This is probably one of the best places for a tourist to catch a sports game from their home town. They have a bunch a big screens and all the sports packages. The bartenders are willing to put on whatever game you are looking for. We went in looking to watch the bruins game and they were happy to put it on for us. Other than that it was a typical Irish pub :-)
